$description: Pocket Nutrition design tokens, DTCG format. TRANSCRIBED VERBATIM from pocket-nutrition-design/foundations/pocket-nutrition.css — every $value below appears literally in that stylesheet. Nothing here is invented or re-derived; when the stylesheet changes, this file is edited to match and scripts/emit_tokens.py is re-run. Both repositories are MPL-2.0 (the client tier, since both ship inside the app binaries), so mirroring the values carries no licence friction; they are mirrored rather than copy-pasted per app because a hand-copied hex drifts and a generated one cannot.

$extensions.pn.note: The sandbox does NOT consume these tokens — it uses raw Tailwind utilities. The native apps are the first clients of the brand palette, so the sandbox screenshots and the apps will differ in colour by design.

paper.$description: Application background. Warm off-white, not #fff — the whole system reads as paper.

cream.$description: Secondary surface: badge backgrounds, progress track, .card-cream.

card.$description: Raised card surface. Pure white, deliberately brighter than paper so a card lifts off the background without needing a shadow.

inverse.$description: Dark surface (.card-dark, .btn-primary fill). Same value as color.brand.leafDeep, kept separate because this is a surface role rather than a brand accent.

default.$description: Primary text. A very dark desaturated green, not black.

soft.$description: Secondary text: .lead, table headers, field help, nav links.

onInverse.$description: Text on a dark surface. Same value as surface.paper.

line.$description: Hairline borders. Deliberately an alpha of ink rather than an opaque grey, so it tints correctly over both paper and cream. A port must keep the alpha — flattening it to an opaque hex breaks it over cream.

leaf.$description: Primary brand green. Also emphasis italics, kickers, and input focus borders.

leafDeep.$description: Deep brand green: primary button fill, active pills, dark cards.

carrot.$description: Accent orange: logo mark, accent buttons, and the focus ring.

carrotSoft.$description: Tint of carrot for accent backgrounds.

status.$description: Accuracy and status semantics. `ok` currently holds the same value as brand.leaf; all six are transcribed as literals rather than aliases so a designer can diverge them without this file misreporting the stylesheet.

ok.$description: Good / high confidence. Currently identical to brand.leaf.

warn.$description: Caution / medium confidence. Also the dashed border of .badge-outline.

hue.$description: Extended categorical hues for food-group and data-source badges. Not semantic — attach no meaning beyond 'a distinct category'.

onSoft.$description: Text colours for use ON the matching *Soft background. These are literal values in the stylesheet's .badge-* rules and are NOT derivable from the base hue, so they must be transcribed. Using a base hue as text on its own soft tint fails contrast — that is precisely why these exist.

chart.$description: Categorical series palette for the nutrition breakdown bars, assigned by ingredient index and wrapping modulo 8. TRANSCRIBED FROM THE SANDBOX (src/components/meal-builder/NutritionPreview.tsx, INGREDIENT_COLORS) rather than from the brand stylesheet — it is the one palette the sandbox states as raw hex instead of Tailwind classes. It is NOT brand-aligned and is a candidate for redesign; whatever happens, the apps must keep the index-to-colour mapping stable so a chart and its legend agree.

display.$description: Headings and stat values: weight 500, line-height 1.06, letter-spacing -0.01em. All five faces are system serifs — the design ships no webfont, so there is nothing to bundle. On Android none of the first four exist; the nearest equivalent is the platform serif (Noto Serif). On iOS, New York is the closest match to Iowan Old Style and is a system face.

body.$description: Body and UI text. This is the system-font stack, so the native equivalent is simply the platform default — Roboto on Android, SF Pro on iOS. Do not bundle a font to chase it.

pill.$description: Buttons, badges, filter pills, progress track. A literal in the stylesheet rather than a :root variable; captured here because a port needs a real number, and 999px means 'fully rounded'.

card.$description: Hover elevation for .card-hover. Note the -20px spread: the shadow is pulled well inside the card's own footprint, which is what keeps it soft rather than a halo. The colour is a tint of leafDeep, not neutral grey.

outExpo.$description: The system's only easing curve. Fast out, long settle.

$extensions.pn.reducedMotion: The stylesheet disables ALL transitions under prefers-reduced-motion. The apps must honour the OS equivalent: ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE on Android, UIAccessibility.isReduceMotionEnabled on iOS.

sectionPad.$description: Vertical section rhythm on the web properties. A fluid CSS value with no direct native equivalent: resolve it per breakpoint (64px floor, 120px ceiling) rather than trying to port clamp().

wrapMax.$description: Max content width (.wrap) = 1152px. Relevant to tablet layouts only.

focus.$description: One focus treatment across the whole system, and it is the accent colour rather than the brand green — deliberately, so focus never reads as 'selected'. Both apps must expose an equivalent visible focus for keyboard and switch-control users.
